tools.name: post_serp
tools.description: The Google SERP Parsing API allows you to extract structured data from Google Search Engine Results Pages (SERPs) with ease. It parses both ads and organic search results, returning a clean and organized JSON response. This is useful for SEO analysis, competitor research, monitoring search rankings,

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "serp-data-scraper" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_serp · Public sink: post_serp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_serp · Public sink: post_serp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
